denominators: all source episodes in right stratum
dependence: Repeated episodes and shared market paths are dependent. Session-balanced mean is weighting disclosure, not an independent sample estimate. No confidence intervals or significance tests.
eligible_statistics: Complete research_only rows with finite underlying.ret, separately by horizon/right/target_aligned; never pool horizons or impute missing returns.
empty_cell: count=0; all return statistics null; no dropping empty aligned-true cells.
exclusions: All campaign ledgers excluded; no quarantine/effective-view claim.
forbidden_claims: precise intended event-time returns when target_aligned=false
population: All 9641 unique canonical episode IDs at source_commit, 2026-08-10 through 2026-09-04; include absent outcome rows in denominator.
post_result_policy: Report every registered cell and missingness. No selecting winners or expanding strata/horizons after inspecting results.
prior_access: Source schemas, covariates, row counts, join validation and coverage metadata examined; no return aggregation yet. Prior history is not an untouched OOS set.
return_unit: Decimal simple underlying return exit_price/entry_price-1; presentation may multiply by100 for percent.
statistics: equal-session mean of per-session means over eligible observations
validation_before_aggregation: Verify exact source hashes against canonical-quality-audit.json.
Unique episode IDs and episode+horizon outcomes, no missing joins.
Use canonical full row validators where available, plus frozen semantic joins; report exactly what was and was not validated.
Fail on any non-finite complete return or inconsistent authority, option availability, status or alignment.
